{{Quote|This is the Gravestone! This was the only ship that ever went up against the Eternal Fleet and won. Do you have any idea how long people have been looking for this thing?|Koth Vortena|<ref name="Gravestone" />}}
Sometime prior to [[4635 BBY]],<ref name="Koth" /> a '''battle''' occurred in the far western reaches of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].

==History==
[[File:Gravestone_and_the_Eternal_Fleet.jpg|thumb|250px|left|The ''Gravestone'' and the Eternal Fleet]]
The [[Droid/Legends|droid]]-controlled [[Eternal Fleet]] was systematically eradicating all life in the [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions]]. The Fleet was finally stopped in a confrontation with the [[Gravestone]], a massive [[Alien/Legends|alien]] [[Frigate/Legends|frigate]] that used its [[Omnicannon]]&mdash;a powerful weapon able to spread damage from a single shot to multiple adjacent targets&mdash;to drive back the [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]]. The Gravestone ultimately proved victorious, forcing the fleet into a state of dormancy somewhere in the Unknown Regions. After the battle, the Gravestone's unknown builders scuttled the ship in the eastern [[Endless Swamp]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Zakuul]], where it was lost to history for centuries, though the story of the battle would became famous.<ref name="Gravestone" />
